I did not set up the recurring "Pod end of day" post, so nothing is scheduled.

I posted two replies in #strategic-pod's thread, and both were wrong in part. The first said I had no scheduling tool, but I do have a cron tool. The second corrected that, but it also said the cron jobs have no Slack access and can't post to the channel. I did not check that. I never created a job, so I don't know what it can reach.

June, I can post the day's new #strategic-pod messages here whenever you ask. For a 17:30 weekday post, someone with the workspace setup would need to confirm whether the scheduler can read this channel and post to it on the Pemberline clock.
